ideias.topic: A lighthouse keeper named Elias and a radio operator named Mara guide a lost fishing boat home through a storm.
Two old friends meet on a train platform after twenty years and one of them finally returns a borrowed watch.
A night-shift nurse convinces a stubborn patient to call his daughter before the morning surgery.
Rosa, a baker, finds a mysterious note inside a sealed flour sack and calls her brother Tomas to help solve it.
A taxi driver realizes his passenger is the stranger who saved his life ten years ago.
A tiny dragon named Ember is afraid of flying until a wise owl teaches her one brave trick.
A robot and a cat on the moon argue about who ate the last space cookie.
A grumpy cactus and a cheerful sunflower share one small window and learn to like each other.
Two penguins plan a surprise birthday party for their friend the walrus, but the walrus is already there.
A lost snowman in the desert asks a camel for directions back to the mountains.
